verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You satisfy my soul
You satisfy my soul
You satisfy my soul with Your love

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You make my heart sing
You lift me on eagle’s wings
Just when I thought that my heart it would faint
You take the darkest night
And turn it to shining light
Just when I thought that the night had won

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Hallelujah, You make all things beautiful
Hallelujah, trials and testing prove there’s gold
Hallelujah, You turn mourning into joy

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
So end the darkest night with the dawning of Your light
Bright and morning star
Oh to be with You where You are

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
Sometimes you gotta sing your way into the truth
You gotta sing your way into the truth
You gotta sing your way into the truth
